title: Length bound for iterated context-preserving maps
statement: Let $f$ map finite bit strings to finite bit strings, and let $A$ be a natural number. Suppose that for every bit string $d$, the first decoded component of $f(d)$ equals the first decoded component of $d$, and $|f(d)|≤|d|+A(|\pi_1(d)|+1)$, where $\pi_1$ denotes the first decoded component, taken to be empty if parsing fails. Then for every bit string $d$ and natural number $j$, $|f^{j}(d)|≤|d|+jA(|\pi_1(d)|+1)$, where $f^j$ denotes $j$-fold iteration.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ maps finite bit strings to finite bit strings
